_comment: A one-sided cap on the fraction of mutants that survive, NOT an exact-count ratchet. The pool is a seeded sample over whichever files a diff put in scope, so an exact count is not comparable between two clean branches; see the header of tests/mutation_table.py. Lower it with --record on a run whose survivors are all explained; raise it only as a deliberate, argued edit.
reason: opening record: both caps start open and are recorded from the first real run of each scope, so the first number is measured rather than assumed
